record.question:
A steel wire, when bent in the form of a square, encloses an area of 121 cm2. If the same wire is bent in
    the form of a circle, then radius of the circle is:
record.explanation: Square side=√121=11 cm, so wire length=44 cm. For the circle, 2πr=44; with π=22/7, r=7 cm.
